notes: Starter filtration variants derived from the local 'Biofilters and solids filters_Corroboration report for aquaponics Layer 1.pdf'.
Only evidence-backed quantitative values clearly supported by the corroboration report are included.

variants.name: Swirl Separator
variants.context: Passive primary solids-separation option for aquaponics or RAS loops where simple gravity-based pretreatment is preferred ahead of downstream biofiltration or finer polishing.
variants.sizing_method: Use clarifier sizing around 15 to 30 minutes hydraulic retention time, with aquaponics operational corroboration around 19 to 20 minutes and tested surface loading anchor 0.0031 m3/s per m2.
expected_benefits: Reduces settleable solids loading on downstream biofilters
maintenance_notes: Maintain inlet and outlet conditions that preserve stable settling behavior.
evidence_notes: Local corroboration report anchor: swirl separator TSS removal about 37.1%.
Distilled pack promotes design HRT about 15 to 30 minutes, with UVI operational corroboration around 19 to 20 minutes and weaker capture around 9.5 minutes.
Distilled pack promotes tested surface loading rate 0.0031 m3/s per m2.
Use as a starter filtration-performance anchor, not as a universal design guarantee.

variants.name: Radial Flow Settler
variants.context: Passive primary solids-separation option for systems needing stronger settleable-solids removal than a swirl separator before biofiltration or polishing filtration.
variants.sizing_method: Use clarifier sizing around 15 to 30 minutes hydraulic retention time, with aquaponics operational corroboration around 19 to 20 minutes and tested surface loading anchor 0.0031 m3/s per m2.
expected_benefits: Higher TSS removal than swirl separation under the corroborated comparison
Reduces solids burden on downstream filters and biofilters
maintenance_notes: Remove settled sludge routinely to prevent re-entrainment.
Check hydraulic leveling and flow distribution to preserve settling performance.
evidence_notes: Local corroboration report anchor: radial-flow settler TSS removal about 77.9%.
Distilled pack promotes design HRT about 15 to 30 minutes, with UVI operational corroboration around 19 to 20 minutes and weaker capture around 9.5 minutes.
Distilled pack promotes tested surface loading rate 0.0031 m3/s per m2.
Use as a starter comparative anchor against swirl separation.

variants.name: Drum Microscreen
variants.context: Active mechanical solids-polishing filter for systems that need finer suspended-solids control after primary settling.
variants.sizing_method: Size by design flow, solids loading, and mesh selection; the corroboration report supports the treatment role but no exact starter sizing coefficient is added here beyond qualitative use after primary solids removal.
expected_benefits: Reduces particulate carryover into biofilters and plant zones
maintenance_notes: Inspect screen fouling and backwash function routinely.
Operate with effective upstream primary solids removal when possible.
evidence_notes: Local corroboration report supports drum microscreen use as a mechanical solids-polishing step.
No exact quantitative starter removal coefficient from the report is included here because it was not one of the clearly supported values provided for this task.

variants.name: Moving Bed Biofilm Reactor
variants.context: Aerated nitrifying biofilter option for systems prioritizing high protected media area and scalable biological treatment.
variants.sizing_method: Use media-volume sizing with feed loading anchor of 8 to 16 kg feed per m3 media per day, then check oxygen, alkalinity, DO, and startup maturity conditions.
expected_benefits: High nitrification capacity per unit media volume
Scalable treatment by adding carrier media
Suitable for dedicated biological treatment stages
maintenance_notes: Maintain adequate aeration for both biofilm mixing and oxygen supply.
Track loading, oxygen demand, and alkalinity demand together during operation.
evidence_notes: Distilled pack promotes MBBR sizing around 8 to 16 kg feed/m3 media/day.
Local corroboration report anchors: nitrification oxygen demand 4.57 g O2 per g ammonia-N and alkalinity demand 7.14 g CaCO3 per g ammonia-N.
Use as a starter biological-capacity anchor only.

variants.name: Fluidized Sand Biofilter
variants.context: High-intensity nitrifying biofilter option for systems seeking very high treatment capacity per media volume with controlled hydraulics.
variants.sizing_method: Use media-volume sizing with feed loading anchor of 16 to 32 kg feed per m3 media per day, then verify oxygen, alkalinity, DO, and startup maturity conditions.
expected_benefits: Higher feed treatment capacity per media volume than the corroborated MBBR anchor
Strong fit for dedicated high-rate nitrification stages
maintenance_notes: Keep hydraulic conditions within the intended fluidization regime.
Track oxygen and alkalinity support because nitrification demand is substantial.
evidence_notes: Distilled pack promotes fluidized sand sizing around 16 to 32 kg feed/m3 media/day.
Local corroboration report anchors: nitrification oxygen demand 4.57 g O2 per g ammonia-N and alkalinity demand 7.14 g CaCO3 per g ammonia-N.
Use as a starter high-rate nitrification anchor.

variants.name: Bead Biofilter
variants.context: Pressurized bead-media biofilter option for compact treatment layouts that combine biological treatment with maintenance-intensive solids handling behavior.
variants.sizing_method: Use system-specific loading validation; the corroboration report supports its filtration role, but no exact starter feed-per-media sizing coefficient is added here beyond oxygen and alkalinity demand anchors for nitrification.
expected_benefits: Can support biological treatment in packaged filter trains
Useful where operators can support regular backwashing
maintenance_notes: Backwash regularly to manage solids accumulation and hydraulic resistance.
Track oxygen and alkalinity support where nitrification is expected.
evidence_notes: Distilled pack promotes bead-system sizing around 16 to 32 kg feed/m3 media/day when washing is frequent.
Local corroboration report anchors used here are nitrification oxygen demand 4.57 g O2 per g ammonia-N and alkalinity demand 7.14 g CaCO3 per g ammonia-N.
No exact bead-biofilter media loading coefficient is included because it was not one of the clearly supported values specified for this task.
Local corroboration report includes UVI context with clarifier sludge removal three times daily.
